tools.name: keyshot_product_render
tools.title: Prepare and render a product
tools.description: Run a complete product workflow in one headless process: open or import, assign materials, configure camera and environment, save a scene copy, and render one or all cameras.

modelPath.description: Absolute path to a model to import. Provide exactly one modelPath or scenePath.

scenePath.description: Absolute path to an existing KeyShot scene. Provide exactly one scenePath or modelPath.

baseScenePath.description: Optional KeyShot base scene used only when modelPath is provided.

outputScenePath.description: Destination for the prepared scene. A safe numbered name is generated when omitted.

renderMode.description: Render one active or named camera, or discover and render every saved camera. Defaults to single.

outputPath.description: Single-mode image destination. Invalid with allCameras mode; a safe name is generated when omitted.

outputDir.description: All-cameras output directory. Invalid with single mode; a safe directory is generated when omitted.

centerGeometry.description: Center imported geometry. Applies only to modelPath sources and defaults to true for new models.

snapToGround.description: Place imported geometry on the ground. Applies only to modelPath sources and defaults to true for new models.

adjustCameraLookAt.description: Retarget the camera after model import. Applies only to modelPath sources and defaults to true for new models.

adjustEnvironment.description: Adjust the environment after model import. Applies only to modelPath sources and defaults to true for new models.

objectName.description: Target object name. Choose exactly one objectName or objectPath.

objectPath.description: Target object's full scene-tree path. Choose exactly one objectPath or objectName.

presetName.description: Material preset name from the configured preset library. Choose one material source.

materialName.description: Material name from the KeyShot library. Choose one material source.

materialPath.description: Absolute path to a local KeyShot material file. Choose one material source.

materialAssignments.description: Object-specific material changes applied before camera and environment setup.

cameraPresetName.description: Configured camera preset to apply. Cannot be combined with a custom position/lookAt pair.

cameraName.description: Camera to create, update, or activate. New model workflows default to Product Hero.

position.description: Camera position [x, y, z]. Must be provided together with lookAt.

lookAt.description: Camera target [x, y, z]. Must be provided together with position.

up.description: Optional camera up direction [x, y, z]. Requires position and lookAt.

distance.description: Positive KeyShot camera distance applied after the transform or preset.

fieldOfView.description: Camera field of view in degrees, greater than 0 and less than 180. Cannot be combined with focalLength.

focalLength.description: Camera focal length from 5 to 200 mm. Cannot be combined with fieldOfView.

environmentName.description: Environment name from the KeyShot library. Cannot be combined with environmentPath.

environmentPath.description: Absolute path to a local KeyShot environment file. Cannot be combined with environmentName.

brightness.description: Positive brightness multiplier for the active environment.

rotation.description: Environment rotation in degrees, from 0 inclusive to 360 exclusive.

width.description: Render width in pixels. Overrides the selected quality preset when provided.

height.description: Render height in pixels. Overrides the selected quality preset when provided.

samples.description: Maximum render samples. Cannot be combined with maxTimeSeconds and overrides preset sampling when provided.

maxTimeSeconds.description: Maximum render time in seconds. Selects time-based rendering and cannot be combined with samples.

format.description: Output image format. Defaults to PNG when omitted.

qualityPreset.description: Render quality preset: preview (960x540, 16 samples), standard (1920x1080, 64 samples), or final (3840x2160, 256 samples).

overwrite.description: Allow replacement of explicitly selected output files. Defaults to false.

continueOnError.description: In allCameras mode, continue after one camera fails. Defaults to true.

ok.description: True when the requested operation completed successfully.

data.description: Operation-specific structured result data, or null when unavailable.

outputFiles.description: Absolute paths of images or scene files created by the operation.

warnings.description: Non-fatal conditions the user or agent should review.

keyshotStdoutTail.description: Truncated tail of KeyShot headless output for diagnostics.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason, or null after success.

errorCode.description: Stable error category for common failures.

suggestions.description: Actionable recovery steps for the user or agent.

tools.name: keyshot_preview_render
tools.title: Render an Agent-visible preview
tools.description: Render a bounded PNG preview from an existing scene and return it directly as MCP image content. Temporary previews are deleted after embedding; an optional safe output path preserves a copy.

scenePath.description: Absolute path to an existing KeyShot scene file to open. Input files may be outside the configured output directory.

camera.description: Optional saved camera name to activate for the preview. Omit to use the scene's active camera.

width.description: Preview width in pixels. Defaults to 960; allowed range is 64 to 1920.

height.description: Preview height in pixels. Defaults to 540; allowed range is 64 to 1080.

samples.description: Preview render samples. Defaults to 16 unless maxTimeSeconds is provided; maximum is 64.

maxTimeSeconds.description: Time-based preview limit in seconds. Replaces the default sample mode and cannot be combined with an explicit samples value; maximum is 60.

outputPath.description: Optional .png destination inside KEYSHOT_OUTPUT_DIR. Existing files are never overwritten. When omitted, a temporary preview is embedded and deleted.

ok.description: True when the requested operation completed successfully.

data.description: Operation-specific structured result data, or null when unavailable.

outputFiles.description: Absolute paths of images or scene files created by the operation.

warnings.description: Non-fatal conditions the user or agent should review.

tools.name: keyshot_sync_saved_scene
tools.title: Sync the latest saved KeyShot scene
tools.description: Find a saved .bip file (or the newest .bip in one folder), detect whether it changed, copy it to a collision-safe output path, and optionally return an Agent-visible preview. This is the stable alternative to unsupported persistent GUI control.

sourcePath.description: Absolute path to a saved .bip scene or a directory whose newest .bip scene should be synchronized. Directories are searched only at their top level.

previousFingerprint.description: Optional fingerprint returned by an earlier sync. When it still matches, no copy or preview is created.

outputScenePath.description: Optional destination for the synchronized .bip copy inside KEYSHOT_OUTPUT_DIR. Existing explicit paths are never overwritten; when omitted, a collision-safe name is generated.

includePreview.description: Whether to render and embed a temporary PNG from the synchronized copy. Defaults to true.

camera.description: Optional saved camera name for the embedded preview. Omit to use the scene's active camera.

width.description: Preview width in pixels. Defaults to 960; allowed range is 64 to 1920.

height.description: Preview height in pixels. Defaults to 540; allowed range is 64 to 1080.

samples.description: Preview render samples. Defaults to 16 unless maxTimeSeconds is provided; maximum is 64.

maxTimeSeconds.description: Time-based preview limit in seconds. Replaces the default sample mode and cannot be combined with an explicit samples value; maximum is 60.
